response.sql:
WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneref AS site_code,
    st.healtheval AS health_safety_status,
    AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_scan_minute,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.healtheval
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_scan_minute) AS mean_group_average
  FROM group_averages
)
SELECT
  g.site_code,
  g.health_safety_status,
  g.avg_gb_per_scan_minute,
  g.scan_count,
  g.avg_gb_per_scan_minute - o.mean_group_average AS amount_above_mean
FROM group_averages AS g
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.mean_group_average IS NOT NULL
  AND g.avg_gb_per_scan_minute > o.mean_group_average
ORDER BY amount_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The date range includes both endpoints; zero-minute scans are excluded from the average because their ratio is undefined, while they remain in the group's scan count.
